ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions in the central and distal portions of both lobes; dense black mottling originating from the peduncle insertion and extending along the inner margin of the notch; localized black clusters and curvilinear marks on the mid-left lobe; vertical black linear streaks on the mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks) distributed along the distal two-thirds of both trailing edges; more irregular, larger-scale undulations present on the right lobe trailing edge compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature near the median notch transitioning into a broad convex curve toward the distal tips, terminating in sharp, tapered points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast white and dark circular pixels (barnacle scars) concentrated along the trailing edge margins and the distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark curvilinear mark on the left lobe resembling a semi-circle; multiple vertical, parallel rake-like marks on the right lobe distal region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical linear scar (rake mark) on the right lobe; unique semi-circular pigmentation or scar pattern on the mid-left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy salt-water spray and droplets partially occluding the pixel data at the center-bottom peduncle region.
